architecture.title: Inter-agent trust — where the hotel decides who Acme is
architecture.caption: The maintenance agent finds its parts vendor by name in a public directory, where anyone can publish a card. With signed_cards, Directory.resolve() accepts a card only if its Ed25519 signature verifies AND its key matches the fingerprint the hotel pinned at onboarding. With signed_messages, every reply that reaches the hotel's A2A endpoint must be signed by that pinned key, fresh (|now − ts| ≤ 300 s), never seen before (nonce) and addressed to this hotel (aud). principal_authz still decides what a vendor's words may trigger. (week28_maestro_mas_security/common/ensemble.py — simulated.)
